text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet finishes her debut and makes it into a special feature article alongside Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Less than pleased at being listed second among the "Future Queens of Racing"…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She vows to claim the number one spot with aplomb in her first Classic race.
